probes: round-4 post-fix positives, same class as the plan's evidence.json receipts
method: each probe registers the real goal_stop.py (copied, with goal_hooks.py) behind a logging wrapper in an isolated throwaway directory, arms a real goal there, and records what the host actually did; the driver is probes-round-4.py in this directory
isolation_note: claude probes must pass --setting-sources project: user-scope hooks on this machine (hindsight memory injection among them) otherwise reach every --print session and derail the probe model - without it the first probe observed a tool-using model reading the copied gate source instead of obeying the probe
